cross_database_findings: APD6 AP03164 and DRAMP29094 represent unoxidized turgencin A; DBAASPR_14835 and DRAMP32226 encode oxidized Met10 (AMox1) with X and must remain separate from unoxidized A.
APD6 AP03165, DBAASPR_14836, and DRAMP29095 represent turgencin B; source Table 1 reports the B fraction as an oxidation-state mixture, so activity values should not be over-normalized to pure Mox0.
DBAASPR_14837/DRAMP32224 and DBAASPR_14838/DRAMP32225 are source-supported BMox1/BMox2 modified-sequence records; X denotes oxidized methionine, not an unknown residue.
DRAMP sequence-literature rows omit PMCID even though the paper-level source is PMC7024374; preserve DOI/PMID/PMCID from paper-level provenance.
DBAASPR_14835 and DRAMP29094 also connect to a later IJMS optimization paper; identity is supported here, but downstream activity rows must be citation-filtered.
